vopros: Are there private schools in West Los Angeles that offer language immersion from preschool through elementary?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Yes. The clearest private-school options in West Los Angeles and nearby Westside neighborhoods are:

| School | Language/program | Span |
|---|---|---|
| **St. Sebastian School** — 1430 Federal Ave., West LA | **English–Spanish dual-language immersion**; preschool is primarily Spanish immersion, with a 50/50 model in TK–elementary and continuing through middle school | Preschool–8th grade |
| **Intiwasi School** — Westside/Los Angeles area | **Spanish–English immersion**, with an IB-aligned, inquiry-based curriculum | Preschool through elementary; confirm the current highest grade, as the program has been expanding |
| **Le Lycée Français de Los Angeles** — multiple West LA campuses | **French–English bilingual/immersion education**; no prior French is generally required | Preschool–12th grade |
| **WorldSpeak School** — Los Angeles/Westside area | Full-immersion options including **Spanish, French, Chinese, German, and Russian** | Preschool through elementary, with some programs extending beyond |
| **Westside Neighborhood School** — Playa Vista | Spanish is taught throughout preschool–8th grade, with a more intensive Spanish immersion option in later grades; it is **not necessarily full immersion from preschool onward** | Preschool–8th grade |

If you want a continuous, strongly immersive preschool-to-elementary pathway, I would start with **St. Sebastian, Intiwasi, Le Lycée Français, and WorldSpeak**. For each school, verify:

- Whether the preschool and elementary campuses are in the same location  
- The percentage of the day taught in the target language  
- Whether entry is possible without prior language exposure  
- The current elementary grades offered—particularly at Intiwasi and WorldSpeak  
- Tuition, admissions deadlines, and availability for your child’s entry year  

**St. Sebastian** appears to be the most directly West-LA-based Spanish dual-language option, while **Le Lycée Français** is the most established French bilingual pathway.

## Preschool and After-School Spanish Classes for Kids in Santa Monica & Malibu
In the Westside of Los Angeles, there are several Dual-Language elementary school options that, even though they are not part of the SMMUSD, are very good options for your children to study Spanish or other languages in a multilingual environment.
#### Worldspeak School
Worldspeak is a school that features full-immersion Spanish, Russian, French and Chinese preschool and elementary programs.
They focus on every child’s unique window of opportunity to help them learn a new language naturally as well as to develop themselves with academic skills such as arts, music, and science, and life skills such as to have fun and being social.
In their Language immersion preschool, native Spanish speakers and teachers from Mexico, guide children through a day filled with activities.
Children play musical instruments, sing songs, build toys, and do some artwork among other things while learning the language.
They also have an Afterschool Language Immersion and STEM program that focuses on Chinese, Spanish, Science, Mathematics, and Coding.
For enrolling in this school, you need to register for an interview or an open house tour.
#### Un Mundo de Amigos Preschool
Un mundo de amigos offers free and fee-for-service preschool education for kids 3-5 years old.
Their mission is to develop active thinkers in a safe, loving dual-language and balanced learning environment that inspires children of diverse backgrounds to fulfill their unlimited potential.
Their child-centered philosophy is committed to developing every aspect of the child’s life by learning through play and exploration and developing great social, emotional, physical, cognitive, and creative skills.
...

MLC is a K-8 public Charter school that was founded with the vision to “bring together a diverse community of learners where cultural and individual differences are the building blocks of academic, social and intrapersonal success.”
